tools.description: Read your Vixel account and current credit balance.
tools.name: film_v1_account

annotations.title: Add an asset to a Work

tools.description: Copy a selected Generator asset into an explicit Work for review. Does not adopt it.
tools.name: film_v1_add_to_work

tools.description: Explicitly accept or reject a reviewed asset for an exact Work target. Requires creator authorization; never infer acceptance from generation completion.
tools.name: film_v1_asset_review

tools.description: List results from the same Generator My Assets library used by the website.
tools.name: film_v1_assets

tools.description: Create or reuse your private Generator workspace for reference uploads.
tools.name: film_v1_ensure_workspace

tools.description: Read the same accepted mainline cut as browser Preview, with owned download paths and export entitlement. Snapshot only; does not render or publish.
tools.name: film_v1_export_manifest

tools.description: Get the owned Work editor or My Assets URL.
tools.name: film_v1_handoff

tools.description: Read an asynchronous Job and its candidate or accepted asset.
tools.name: film_v1_job

tools.description: Read the live configured Film model catalog and capabilities; availability is not provider execution proof.
tools.name: film_v1_models

tools.description: Replace the complete production plan with Elements and Shots on the exact revision. Preserve unrelated targets. The initial plan requires a saved Script. Does not approve media or start generation.
tools.name: film_v1_plan_save

tools.description: Prepare a reviewable opening-image candidate for a Shot. Does not adopt it, generate media or charge credits.
tools.name: film_v1_production_frame_prepare

tools.description: Start the exact approved production quote within the user's credit ceiling. May spend credits. Retry the original body/key; review results before adoption.
tools.name: film_v1_production_generate

tools.description: Save creative beats and cast as a production plan for the explicitly approved Script and existing Story. Replaces the full plan; preserve unrelated content. No media or charge.
tools.name: film_v1_production_plan

tools.description: Quote an image or video for an exact Element or Shot of the Work. This is how agents make media: Vixel prepares prompts and references from the approved Script and production plan. User direction describes the desired result. No Job, crop, mutation or charge.
tools.name: film_v1_production_quote

tools.description: Read the canonical Work, revision, Script documents, scenes, Elements, Shots, assets and Timeline. Use returned IDs and write version, never guess the latest Work.
tools.name: film_v1_project

tools.description: Start a new film, image or video here: every Vixel image and video is produced inside a Work. Creates an empty Work within the same account allowance as the website. Does not call Director, generate a Story or spend credits. Save its Script next.
tools.name: film_v1_project_create

tools.description: List your existing Film Works before choosing an explicit project. Does not create a Work.
tools.name: film_v1_projects

tools.description: Prepare an immutable release from a reviewed accepted video. Does not post to any channel.
tools.name: film_v1_release_create

tools.description: Verify final MP4 bytes and save through the existing release artifact receipt owner.
tools.name: film_v1_release_upload_finalize

tools.description: Prepare upload of a reviewed final MP4 for the exact Work revision. Does not publish externally.
tools.name: film_v1_release_upload_intent

tools.description: List prepared revision-bound releases. Prepared does not mean published.
tools.name: film_v1_releases

tools.description: Look up the original durable Job after a timeout; never create a replacement key.
tools.name: film_v1_request

tools.description: Resume the same blocked Job after top-up; may spend credits.
tools.name: film_v1_resume

tools.description: Save the initial Script document before Story/Elements/Shots. Requires the exact Work revision and a stable key. No generation, approval or credits.
tools.name: film_v1_screenplay_create

tools.description: Read the current Work revision and canonical Script document, or null if absent. Does not create anything.
tools.name: film_v1_screenplay_get

tools.description: Revise the exact existing Script document with a revision guard and stable key. Does not update Story/Plan, approve production or generate media.
tools.name: film_v1_screenplay_update

tools.description: Replace one Shot's visual Element bindings through the canonical owner. Preserve required on-screen identities.
tools.name: film_v1_shot_references

tools.description: Replace the complete Story graph on the exact Work revision. Preserve unrelated scenes. Save the Script first. Returns the existing canonical mutation receipt; no media generation.
tools.name: film_v1_story_save

tools.description: Reconcile the same Job under existing platform recovery rules.
tools.name: film_v1_sync

tools.description: Apply bounded typed Timeline edits to the exact revision; returns its durable receipt. Full-source retiming requires the creator's confirmation in web Preview. Does not generate media.
tools.name: film_v1_timeline_patch

tools.description: Revert one existing Timeline receipt with the current revision guard.
tools.name: film_v1_timeline_undo

tools.description: Verify uploaded bytes and record a reference through the existing receipt boundary.
tools.name: film_v1_upload_finalize

tools.description: Prepare a bounded reference upload; send bytes only to the returned signed URL without OAuth headers.
tools.name: film_v1_upload_intent

tools.description: Inspect your Generator workspace without creating one.
tools.name: film_v1_workspace
